description: GPU toolkit and toolchain matrix for porting. Covers GPU backends (ROCm, CUDA, oneAPI, OpenVINO) AND host toolchains (MSVC, MinGW, MSYS2, GCC, Clang).

rocm.name: ROCm 10.1 / ROC 10.1 (AMD's new branding)

version_history.branding_change: ROCm 7.14.0 was the first production release on TheRock build system. ROCm 7.2 was the last legacy release. AMD jumped 7.x → 10.x branding for ROCm.AI initiative.
breaking_changes_from_rocm_7_2: hipBLAS + rocBLAS combined into amdrocm-blas package
ROCm SMI replaced by AMD SMI (amd-smi CLI)
HIP version macro clang_major now reports 24 (was 19)
HIPCC and FLANG no longer standalone packages
new_components_in_10_1: hipThreads — GPU concurrency library for incremental CPU-thread→GPU acceleration
ROCm CLI v0.2.0 — single-binary installer with TUI dashboard
AMD Infinity Storage + hipFILE — direct storage→GPU without CPU staging
NUMA-aware host memory allocation (hipMemCreate with hipMemLocationTypeHostNuma)
Coarse-grained memory coherency on Windows (hipHostRegister w/ hipExtHostRegisterCoarseGrained)

rocm.min_version: ROCm 7.0 / ROC 10.1 (current branding: AMD renamed ROCm 7.16 internal to 'ROC 10.1', a complete rewrite from ROCm 7.2 based on TheRock build system)

blas_backend.description: rocBLAS uses Tensile (built-in) and hipBLASLt (external) for GEMM. Selection is automatic per-arch.
blas_backend.rdna2_note: gfx103X uses Tensile only: hipBLASLt not supported. Build via TheRock PR #1629 for full gfx1031 support. Use HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=10.3.0 on Windows.
blas_backend.roc_10_1_notes: ROC 10.1 (HIP 7.16, LLVM 24): install dir is /opt/rocm/core-10.1, packages are amdrocm-*. hipThreads library added. AMD SMI replaces ROCm SMI. hipBLAS+rocBLAS combined into amdrocm-blas.

windows.msvc_compat: Requires MSVC 2022 (v143) or newer as host compiler

sdk_paths.desc: Primary ROCm install root from environment variable

windows.notes: Windows ROCm: requires ROCm 6.0+; HIP runtime ships as DLL; may need HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX=gfx1201 for RDNA4

sdk_paths.desc: Primary ROCm install root from environment variable

linux.notes: Standard setup; hipblaslt tuning tables in tools/hip/*.txt

rocm.notes: hipcc compiles .cu as HIP language. rocWMMA required for WMMA path on gfx1100/1150/1151; absent on gfx1030/gfx1200/gfx1201 (portable F32 fallback). The WMMA/CooperativeMatrix extensions must be verified per-target-arch using kands://isa-references.

cuda.name: CUDA (NVIDIA)

nvcc_flags.fmad: --fmad=true (FMA contraction; --fmad=false to disable for bit-exact parity)

windows.compiler: cl.exe with nvcc wrapper (MSVC host compiler required)
windows.notes: nvcc invokes cl.exe for host code. Need Windows SDK include paths set. Use --compiler-bindir to point nvcc at MSVC.

linux.compiler: nvcc with gcc/g++ or clang/clang++ as host compiler
linux.notes: Standard setup via apt/yum install nvidia-cuda-toolkit. For bit-exact parity with Windows builds, ensure same host compiler version.

cuda.notes: CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES must be >= 75. Uses --use_fast_math for native_* kernels. Tensor core path (mma_now()) active on sm_80+.

oneapi.name: Intel oneAPI DPC++/C++

windows.msvc_compat: Requires MSVC 2019+ (v142) or 2022 (v143) as host compiler

linux.compiler: icpx (SYCL + C++), or gcc/g++ with oneMKL runtime

oneapi.notes: Targets Intel Arc discrete GPUs and integrated GPUs via SYCL/DPC++. Can emit SPIR-V for Vulkan. DPAS matrix instruction on Arc. EU subgroups of 8 threads (vs AMD wave32).

openvino.name: OpenVINO
openvino.notes: Post-training quantization + model optimizer. Not a compiler; wraps oneAPI/DPC++ for Intel GPU inference. Good for INT8/GPTQ quantized LLMs on Arc.

vulkan.name: Vulkan Compute

cooperative_matrix.nvidia: GL_NV_cooperative_matrix — supported on SM 7.5+ via driver 535.x+
cooperative_matrix.amd: GL_KHR_cooperative_matrix — **BROKEN** on AMD drivers (radv/AMDVLK). Must use DP4a (spv_dp4) fallback.
cooperative_matrix.intel: GL_KHR_cooperative_matrix — supported on Arc A-Series via igc

dp4a_fallback.usage: Standard matmul on AMD Vulkan where CooperativeMatrix is broken

windows.notes: Vulkan SDK from LunarX. For DX12 interop: VK_KHR_external_semaphore_win32.

linux.notes: Use glslc for GLSL→SPIR-V. spirv-val for validation. Mesa radv or AMDVLK for AMD.

vulkan.notes: Cross-platform compute via SPIR-V. AMD Vulkan: CooperativeMatrix broken — use DP4a. NVIDIA Vulkan: CooperativeMatrix supported natively.

directx12.name: Direct3D 12 / DirectML / DXC

compiler.dxil_dll: dxil.dll (DXIL runtime, part of DirectX Agility SDK)

directx12.dxc_compiler_notes: DXC (DirectX Shader Compiler) compiles HLSL to DXIL. Use -T cs_6_6 / -T cs_6_7 for compute shaders. The Agility SDK (nuget) provides headers for D3D12 v1.2+ APIs including enhanced barriers (Rebar).

directx12_agility_sdk.description: Provides latest D3D12 features without OS update — essential for enhanced barriers, Rebar, and mesh shaders

rebar.description: Resizable BAR / Rebar GPU memory mapping — allows CPU to access full GPU VRAM
rebar.notes: Requires motherboard + GPU + CPU support. Enables zero-copy staging buffers for large models. Check via IDXGISubResourceInvariant or DXGI_ADAPTER_FLAG_SOFTWARE.

directml.description: High-level GPU-accelerated ML inference on Direct3D 12

windows.notes: DXC is the modern HLSL compiler (open-source, LLVM-based). Replaces legacy fxc. For Python ML: use DirectML or ONNX Runtime with DML execution provider.

linux.notes: Direct3D 12 / DirectML / DXC is Windows-only. Use Vulkan or OpenVINO for Linux GPU compute.

directx12.notes: HLSL → DXIL via DXC (LLVM-based). DirectX Agility SDK provides latest D3D12 features. DirectML wraps D3D12 for ML inference. Rebar support for large model VRAM access.

msvc.name: Microsoft Visual C++ (MSVC)
msvc.notes: For standalone compilation: set Windows SDK include/lib paths. CUDA builds: nvcc wraps cl.exe for host code. HIP on Windows: needs hipcc + Windows SDK.

mingw.name: MinGW-w64 (GCC for Windows)
mingw.compiler: g++.exe (or x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++ for cross-compile on Linux)
mingw.notes: Alternative to MSVC; useful for simpler builds. Does NOT support CUDA (needs nvcc with MSVC host). HIP compilation via mingw not officially supported.

msys2.name: MSYS2 (Unix-like environment for Windows)
msys2.notes: C:\msys64 is the standard MSYS2 root. Can install both MinGW and Clang toolchains in parallel. hipcc can be built from source via MSYS2.

clang.name: Clang (LLVM)
clang.notes: On Linux, hipcc uses Clang/LLVM under the hood. On Windows, clang-cl can act as MSVC replacement if MSVC SDK is available.

strawberry.name: Strawberry Perl
strawberry.notes: NOT a C++ compiler — provides Perl for build scripts. Required alongside MSVC or MinGW for many GPU SDK installers and build systems (e.g., amdocl, Vulkan SDK build scripts, some ROCm Makefiles). Ensure C:\Strawberry\perl\bin is in PATH before running build scripts.
